spans.s: to be attended to or noticed, MBh.; Kathās.
to be known or perceived or observed or recognized, perceptible, intelligible, Up.; MBh. &c.
to be enlightened or admonished or instructed or informed, one who is informed, Pañcat.; Sāh.
to be awakened or aroused, MW.
it is to be watched or be awaked, Pañcat. (v.l. प्र-ब्˚).
बोद्धृ, बोध, बौद्ध &c. See p. 734, col. 2.
one who perceives or comprehends, Sāh.
one who knows or is versed in (loc. or comp.), ChUp.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c. (-त्व n., Kap.)
